description: AGSC-09-19 (1): under MCP revision 2026-07-28 there is no `initialize`: a request carries its revision and capabilities in `_meta`, and `server/discover` is implemented. The frames contain one request, `server/discover`, with `_meta` and no handshake before it. The result is `{resultType: "complete", supportedVersions, capabilities, ttlMs, cacheScope, _meta}`: `supportedVersions` is `["2026-07-28", "2025-11-25"]` on standard input and output (a client of the earlier revision is still served there); `capabilities` carries `prompts`, `resources` and `tools` and the `extensions` map with `com.agenticsystemcore/knowledge` and its settings object, whose one member `linkset` is the absolute URL of the node's `/.well-known/knowledge-linkset` (AGSC-11-18; the fixture's `site.base` is `https://minimal.example/`); `ttlMs` is 0 and `cacheScope` is `private`; `_meta` names the server. Only the members stated here are compared. Derived from the revision's `server/discover` page read on 2026-10-29.
